p: when the morning is light: As soon as they rise, they execute their wicked devices of the night, and according to their ability hurt others.
We be utterly spoiled: Thus the Jews lament and say that there is no hope of restitution, seeing their possessions are divided among the enemies.
the congregation of the LORD: You will have no more lands to divide as you had in times past, and as you used to measure them in the Jubilee.
Prophesy ye not: Thus the people warn the prophets that they speak to them no more, for they cannot endure their threatenings.
they shall not prophesy to them: God says that they will not prophesy, nor receive any more of their rebukes or taunts.
are these his doings: Are these your works according to his Law?
that walketh uprightly: Do not the godly find my words comfortable?
of late my people is risen: That is, in past times.
robe with the garment from them: The poor can have no benefit from them, but they rob them, as though they were enemies.
my glory for ever: That is, their substance and living, which is God's blessing, and as it were part of his glory.
rest: Jerusalem will not be your safeguard, but rather the cause of your destruction.
walking in the spirit and falsehood: That is, show himself to be a prophet.
I will prophesy unto thee of: He shows what prophets they delight in, that is, in flatterers, who tell them pleasant tales, and speak of their benefits.
all of thee: To destroy you.
breaker is come up before them: The enemy will break their gates and walls, and lead them into Chaldea.
on the head of them: To drive them forward, and to help their enemies.
